BLUE_DATA_REGISTRY_PATH.prompt: Path to the blue-data registry to plan over

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_MODEL.prompt: litellm model string every planner component uses

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_REASONING_EFFORT.prompt: Reasoning effort a reasoning model spends per call (minimal, low, medium, high, none; off omits the parameter, for a model that does not support it)

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_OPERATORS.prompt: Operator suites to register, comma separated (builtin, lotus, blue)

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_LOTUS_MODEL.prompt: litellm model string LOTUS configures for itself; unset, LOTUS uses the planner's model

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_LOTUS_REASONING_EFFORT.prompt: Reasoning effort LOTUS's own model spends per call (minimal, low, medium, high, none; off omits the parameter, for a model that does not support it)

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_LOTUS_MAX_ROWS.prompt: Rows a LOTUS operation accepts before refusing the call

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_MAX_OPERATOR_CALLS.prompt: Operator calls one request may spend

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_MAX_FAILURE_REPLANS.prompt: Times an operator failure may trigger a replan

BLUE_DATA_PLANNER_MAX_CONTROL_REPLANS.prompt: Times a control node may trigger a replan
